race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: TRUSTINTIMES can call upon a very good strike rate and with this trip sure to suit on second Flat start, he can find the necessary improvement required to land this. Liam Mera Kai is a definite threat back on a left-handed track, with Rowlf another potential improver. TRUSTINTIMES LIAM MERA KAI (FR) ROWLF
